prompt: Create an original 180 second Indian acoustic instrumental instrumental composition for mystery, nocturnal exploration and restrained suspense. Mood: mysterious, tense, nocturnal. Instruments: sitar, bansuri, tabla, tanpura. Style: gradually unfolding modal melody and intricate tabla. Tempo approximately 80 BPM; G minor. Main idea: alternating short and long phrases. Use unresolved suspended harmony, careful space and subtle low-register movement; no jump scares. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-01:00] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [01:00-02:00] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [02:00-03:00] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 03:00.

description.en: A serene and meditative piece featuring traditional Indian-inspired instrumentation. A plucked string instrument (sitar-like) carries the main melody, accompanied by a gentle flute and subtle percussion, creating a calm and reflective atmosphere.
description.zh: 一首宁静而冥想的乐曲，采用印度传统乐器风格。拨弦乐器（类似西塔琴）演奏主旋律，伴随着柔和的长笛和微妙的打击乐，营造出平静而沉思的氛围。

metadataBasis: style/scenario/tempo/key/moods are prompt intent; duration is measured; energy and audioReview are model inference when energyBasis is automated-audio-review
